ValidationRule.description: Stops the user from changing the fields: Sales_Org__c, Distribution_Channel__c, Account_Org__c and Custom_Id__c excepts if the Custom_Id__c is previously empty
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", OR( ISCHANGED(Sales_Org__c), ISCHANGED(Distribution_Channel__c), ISCHANGED(Account_Org__c), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Custom_Id__c))), ISCHANGED(Custom_Id__c)) ))
